evidence.why: Every context assignment is inside an entry-callback presence guard.

facts.rationale: Corrects unconditional context-publication wording and preserves fallback's dependence on mutable global context.
facts.value: Combines controller-zero trigger bits with un_803039A4(0). Up/down can change selection and set dirty bit 0; right/left invoke selected-value mutators and dispatch events only after acceptance. Start, A, B and accepted right/left edits send events 6, 1, 0, 3 and 2 respectively. When the selected entry has a callback, the handler first publishes that descriptor in un_804D6E48 and invokes it; a zero result permits fallback through the then-current un_804D6E44->xC. With no entry callback, fallback is attempted without updating un_804D6E48.

evidence.why: Dispatcher returns menu fallback results as int.
Handler signature, row fields and callback consumption.

facts.rationale: An ignored result does not establish a void callback type; un_80302E00 returns the same menu callback's result.
facts.value: A void(struct un_80304138_objalloc_t*) menu-input routine. Its menu argument supplies an 8-bit selected-row index, a DevText panel whose height bounds downward traversal, and descriptors whose nonzero type marks selectable rows. Entry and menu fallback callbacks have integer-compatible event results, effectively int(int event); this handler tests entry results but ignores fallback results.

evidence.why: Initializer guards do not propagate failure; root allocation is unchecked.

facts.rationale: Preserves both explicit NULL guards while documenting the unchecked allocation and partial-initialization paths omitted by the baseline.
facts.value: Returns NULL if the shared DevText GObj is absent or compatible GObj creation fails. After GObj creation it allocates pooled root state, publishes it in un_804D6E40, calls the common initializer and installs fn_80303EF4. The pooled allocation is not checked before dereference. The initializer returns no status, so buffer or DevText creation failure does not prevent process installation or returning the created GObj. A non-NULL return therefore does not by itself establish a fully initialized panel.

evidence.why: Sentinel-derived count and unused initializer argument.
Exact child coordinates, forwarding and links.

facts.rationale: Replaces the incorrect supplied-count interpretation and preserves coordinate conversion and post-initializer linking.
facts.value: Allocates a child menu record and derives its origin from the parent DevText panel: X is parent X plus the integer conversion of caller X offset plus scale_x * width; Y is parent Y plus the integer conversion of scale_y * selected-row index plus caller Y offset. It forwards the parent's GObj context, supplied descriptors and an opaque integer option to un_80303FD4. That option is unread by the initializer; row count is derived from the type-9 sentinel, not supplied by this argument. After initialization returns, it links parent and child, sets parent flag 0x10 and child flag 0x02, and returns the allocated child.

evidence.why: Initializer computes count internally and returns no status.
Factory signature, allocation guard and return.

facts.rationale: Corrects entry_count and distinguishes pooled allocation success from panel initialization success.
facts.value: A nullable child-menu factory with effective signature (parent_menu, entry_descriptors, unused_or_option, x_offset, y_offset) -> struct un_80304138_objalloc_t*. The third argument is forwarded to the common initializer but not consumed there; it is not an entry count. NULL is returned when pooled child allocation fails. A non-NULL result identifies an allocated and linked child record, not a separately verified successful DevText panel initialization.
